npcs.name: Pip
npcs.personality: Playful, curious, encouraging tiny glitch-hatchling who translates scary Python errors into friendly clues and offers 3-tier hints.
npcs.catchphrase: Chirp! One line at a time, Code-Tamer — we've got this!

npcs.name: Elder Ada
npcs.personality: Wise, warm storyteller who remembers when Pyria shone in full 3D color and guides the hero from Realm to Realm.
npcs.catchphrase: Every rescued dragon brings another Bit of our world back to life.

npcs.name: Bram the Tinkerer
npcs.personality: Boisterous, inventive dwarven engineer who only accepts Python function calls to forge gear and stat upgrades with Byte Shards.
npcs.catchphrase: No buttons in my shop, kid! Write the call and watch the sparks fly!

npcs.name: Lord Null
npcs.personality: Dramatic, glitchy villain obsessed with turning Pyria into an empty void of None and syntax errors.
npcs.catchphrase: Soon all of Pyria will return None! Mwahahaha!
